common_composition: The shared matching/placement APIs are deny-only and their required guards reserve the corresponding native targets. No coexistence proof or guard relaxation is performed here.

callers.observed_role: Crafting-station self-ingredient subtraction and anvil RequiredMaterial/component match.
callers.migration_boundary: Matching veto is a candidate; preserve consumer interest, cropped cell order and component availability. No output authority.

callers.observed_role: Refuse a seared gauge with any present tank payload when making melter/cannon. Zero-amount compound and malformed payload remain refused.
callers.migration_boundary: Matching veto is a candidate; TankItem/NoContainer policy stays in TConstruct.

callers.observed_role: Clones shield-bearing input, changes owned custom_data and returns replacement output; separate remainder hook recomputes plan over the original grid.
callers.migration_boundary: Not a veto. Requires one authoritative generation/consumption of the same output/remainder pair. Staging API is not automatic craft authority.

callers.observed_role: Local crafting station only; refresh, native menu placement, drop/component-count validation, accepted grid persistence and UI updates.
callers.migration_boundary: Not a deny-only replacement. Needs actor/menu/slot conservation/authoritative commit boundaries; remote and LAN acting path explicitly fall through.

limitations: No planner, Rust, gameplay or LAN execution.
Old hooks unchanged. Initial pin incompatibility remains separate from authority conflicts.
Overslime component preservation and paired automatic crafting remain unproved by deny-only APIs.
Do not import accumulated branch trees or weaken exclusive guards to make coexistence pass.

matching_facts_audit.source_identity: Common remote crafting-match.rs and component-view.rs read back byte-identical to local source. Other API declarations below were inspected at the named local source, not assumed from a newer branch.
available_facts: Form::Shaped width/height and Ingredient::accepted_ids retain the crafting-station subtraction signature. InputFacts.cells retain actual stack IDs, slot order and holes; flattening occupied cells reproduces native Input::stacks, without filtering count-zero present cells.

For the relevant fixed templates, Template::create clones item/count/damage/extra. Request.result is its captured semantic view, not an output replacement. Missing template item becomes minecraft:air natively and cannot match these named results.

Without root or nested retained Wire, encoded minecraft:custom_data keeps its native Tag variant and contents. StackData::other selects the first matching entry; components_tag uses first-entry or_insert for this unmodeled key. canonical_other_component only specializes map_decorations, so it does not normalize custom_data.

ComponentValue preserves typed values and UTF-16 units. The old RequiredMaterial/Material equality explicitly uses JavaString::to_string_lossy; consumer migration must use the equivalent String::from_utf16_lossy rather than the public strict ComponentText::to_string helper.

A missing tank lookup is different from a present empty/zero-amount Compound, Int(0), String, List or End. Old survival policy refuses every present value, not merely a positive amount. Malformed parent custom_data is different from a malformed present tank: the former makes native Tag::get return None and therefore passes the old empty-tank predicate.

blocking_gap.condition: contains_retained_wire(stack) recursively checks the root and nested stacks; any retained wire makes the entire components view unavailable.
blocking_gap.old_behavior: Both old policies read StackData::other(minecraft:custom_data) directly even when unrelated retained wire exists; anvil also reads this field on its created result.
blocking_gap.consequence: Current public facts cannot distinguish absent from present tank/material data in that condition. Treating unavailable as absent can admit an old denial; blanket refusal can reject an old pass. Neither is proven equivalent.
blocking_gap.minimum_needed: A synchronous read of the same native stack's explicitly stored preserved component by caller-supplied key, retaining absent versus present and exact Tag kind/UTF-16. This is a semantic read of StackData::other, not the complete effective prototype, retained-wire decoding, save identity or mutation authority. Keep it distinct from existing components availability; do not silently weaken that field's contract.
blocking_gap.ownership: Any host access/conversion belongs to Pluto's internal adapter. TConstruct keeps keys, RequiredMaterial comparison, fake-block count and tank eligibility. No additional owner, registry, global state or result/commit authority is required by this proposal.

required_differential_cases: Exact crafting-station width/height/ingredient signature versus nearby shapes and input IDs, including holes and a present count-zero stack.
Anvil result missing/wrong-type RequiredMaterial; 2/3/4 fake blocks; matching/mismatching/missing/wrong-type Material; invalid UTF-16 strings with the same lossy rendering.
Gauge custom_data absent/noncompound/compound-without-tank versus tank empty compound, amount zero, positive amount, End, scalar and list.
Repeat representative pass/deny inputs with usable or stale root Wire and Wire only in a nested stack; result-template Wire with RequiredMaterial still present.
Direct old policy result versus any proposed shared-provider policy, retaining the existing no-provider native continuation and target exclusivity guard.
matching_facts_audit.verification: Read-only source comparison only. No Rust/model execution, provider implementation, plan, coexistence or gameplay proof.
